open_up.speaker: Mira
text: It's five in the morning. Mira presses the keys into your hand.
"The oven broke in the night. There's one loaf left from yesterday. I have to fetch the repair man, so whoever comes in first... you decide."

nurse.speaker: Jo
text: A nurse comes in, still in her uniform, eyes half closed.
"Twelve hours on the ward. Please tell me there's bread."

options.o: Jo holds it like it's treasure. "You've saved my morning."
Jo nods slowly and shuffles back out into the cold.
You tear it carefully. Jo laughs. "Half is plenty."

kid.speaker: Sam
text: The bell rings again. A boy counts coins onto the counter.
"I've got sixty pence. Is that enough for bread? It's for my nan."

text.t: The shelf behind you is empty.
text.else: The bread is still on the shelf behind you.

options.o: Sam pockets his coins. "That's okay. I'll try the shop."

options.t: Give Sam the other half for free.
Give Sam the loaf for free.
options.o: "For free? Really?" He runs out before you can change your mind.
Sam slides the coins across. Fair is fair.
Sam slides the coins across and takes the half loaf.

landlord.speaker: Mr Pike
text: Mr Pike, who owns the building, is waiting outside.
"Rent's due on Friday. And I hear you've been giving bread away. Tell me what's going on in there."

options.t: Tell him the truth about the oven.
options.o: He listens, arms folded, then sighs.
"A delivery problem," you say. He doesn't look convinced.

close.speaker: Mira
text: Mira comes back with the repair man just as the sun comes up.

text.t: "I passed Jo and Sam on the way. They couldn't stop talking about you."
text.else: "Quiet morning?" she asks, looking at the counter.
